text:
emma: Heads-up — SEO playbook for the launch + webinar routing. Need quick alignment on three things: 1) redirects & legacy URL mappings, 2) schema for webinar + benchmarks, 3) internal linking plan for funnel pages. Quick thread.

raj: dropping notes from my content review. main concerns: duplicate short summaries under /blog and /docs, and a handful of old campaign pages linking to the old webinar form.

becky: can you paste the list of legacy urls? i'll map anchors.

raj: sure — small CSV to start, will upload to the sheet after: 

```
old_path,new_canonical,redirect_type,reason,anchor_examples
/campaigns/2022/benchmark-alpha,/blog/launch-inference-benchmarks,301,outdated campaign,"LLM benchmarks, inference speed"
/blog/old-benchmarks-summary,/blog/launch-inference-benchmarks,302,short duplicate,"benchmarks summary"
/webinar-old-signup,/webinar/register,301,deprecated form,"register for webinar"
/docs/old-latency-guide,/docs/latency,302,broke into docs sections,"latency comparison"
/benchmarks/methods,/blog/benchmarks-methods,301,methodology moved,"methodology, appendix"
```

patrick: 302 for staging-only vanity pages ok, but final should be 301. Also confirm no-js pages return proper canonical headers (we had an issue last quarter).

seo_ops_bot: Reminder: content freeze 20:00 PST tonight. Any redirect PRs must land after approval and be staged post-freeze.

ryan: For schema: Webinar needs Event schema + potential VideoObject (if recording will be embedded) + FAQ schema on the register page. Benchmarks: use Article + Dataset schema for the raw numbers table, and mark the methodology pages with howTo/schema where applicable. Example snippet: 

```
<script type=\"application/ld+json\">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference launch: live benchmarks webinar",
  "startDate": "2025-04-15T16:00:00-07:00",
  "endDate": "2025-04-15T17:00:00-07:00",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/register"}
}
</script>
```

becky: good. Also add OpenGraph tags for the benchmark post (og:title, og:description, og:image) and set twitter:card to summary_large_image. Many partners will share the link on socials during the webinar window.

emma: internal linking: top priority is funnel pages -> webinar register -> benchmark summary -> methodology. We should ensure the register CTA appears in the benchmark post hero, and the blog links back to product docs for deep dives. If a docs page has less than 300 words and duplicates blog content, either merge or add canonical to the blog.

raj: agree. small guideline: when moving content, preserve the most descriptive anchor text (avoid generic "click here") and keep at least one contextual sentence around the link for SERP signals.

patrick: crawl plan: i'll run a focused crawl on the affected namespaces and produce a link-count report. If any old campaign page has >25 inbound internal links, escalate to priority redirect and keep original anchor text in mapping.

ryan: note on redirects — use pattern-based 301s for campaign pages (/campaigns/* -> /blog/launch-inference-benchmarks) but whitelist exceptions where slug semantics differ. Also ensure the redirect preserves utm params when present.

becky: can we add a short checklist for content PRs? to avoid common misses.

emma: yes — propose this checklist below, we'll add to the repo README: 

- meta title + meta description written and under 70/160 chars
- canonical tag set (or removed) depending on consolidation decision
- schema snippet present for Event/Article/Dataset as needed
- OG + twitter tags verified
- internal CTAs to /webinar/register included where relevant
- redirect mapping documented in redirects.csv 

raj: i'll own the redirects.csv and post the first pass by 15:30.

seo_ops_bot: Note: staging preview URLs available at https://preview.redwood.ai/<pr-number>. Confirm preview renders schema via view-source for verification.

patrick: action items: i'll upload crawl report by 17:00; ryan, can you draft the pattern-based redirect rules?

ryan: on it. will include sample nginx/edge rules and ensure query param passthrough.

becky: i'll update the blog PR template with the checklist and add one line about preserving anchor text.

emma: final call — aim to freeze content by 19:00, redirects finalized by 21:00, and infra to apply staged 301s after the deploy window. thanks team. :rocket: 

seo_ops_bot: Maintenance window reminder: 23:00 - 02:00 PST. Any edge deployment scheduled outside this window may be delayed.

raj: ack. thanks everyone.
